pairs.difference: A: the ring is a thick, even loop and the body is plump with a swollen round end cap. B: the ring is thinner and partly tucked behind the body, and the mouthpiece edge is crisper. The silhouettes are very close.
pairs.fix: Draw the key ring as a thin wire loop. Make the whistle body leaner with tighter, crisper edges.

pairs.difference: A: the two tassels are huge, fat and lumpy, much larger than the knot. The cord stubs are thick, and the rope knot is a chunky bulb. B: the tassels are small, the cords thin, and the rope wrap is a tidy band.
pairs.fix: Draw thin cords ending in small, slim tassels. Make the rope knot a tight wrap. Keep the tassels well under the size of the horn bell.

pairs.difference: B: the cup is tall and plump, with a thick rolled rim, a fat sausage handle and a heavy saucer edge. B's silhouette is a big blob. A: the cup is shallower and the handle thinner, and the saucer edge is slim.
pairs.fix: Draw a slimmer cup with a thin lip. Make the handle a slender curve and the saucer edge thin and flat. Keep the proportions like real porcelain.

pairs.difference: Both baskets have a similar thick twisted handle and a similar rounded body. B has extra leaves, but that is a part-count difference more than a form difference. No reliable shape cue.

B: the straps are bulging, with rivet bumps along the contour. The staves are swollen and the rim is a thick rounded lip, so the outline is scalloped and toy-like. A: the outline is smoother, the hoops are thin and flush, and the staves are flat-faced.
pairs.fix: Draw flat metal hoops that sit flush on the barrel. Use thin staves with straight seams and no bulging bands. Make the top rim thin.

pairs.difference: A: the car is boxy and fattened like a toy. The roof sign is oversized, the bumper and grille are huge, and the wheel arches and headlights bulge out of the contour. B: the car is lower and more realistically proportioned, with a cleaner contour.
pairs.fix: Draw realistic car proportions with a lower body. Use a small roof sign, a slim bumper and tight wheel arches. Keep the headlights flush with the body.

pairs.difference: A: the tent is crowded with parts. It has crossed poles on top, thick stakes with rope wraps, a lantern on a rock and chunky stubby stakes in the silhouette. The result is a busy outline. B: a plain tent with thin guy lines and straight planar flaps.
pairs.fix: Draw a simple tent with straight canvas planes. Use thin guy lines and small stakes. Leave out the lantern, rock and rope bundles.

pairs.difference: A: the pot is a fat, rounded blob. The handle and rings are thick, the log is a chunky bumpy shape, and the pot merges into a mass of rocks and fire. Only one support leg shows. B: the support frame has two thin poles, a thin bail handle and a flat bar, and the pot silhouette is clean.
pairs.fix: Draw thin poles, a thin wire bail handle and a slim pot with a crisp rim. Keep the rocks and fire small and separate from the pot outline.

pattern: Generated cards fatten and add parts. Straps, cords, handles and tassels turn into thick sausage shapes. Corners and contours are rounded and scalloped into soft blobs. Extra props such as rivets, rocks, lanterns and leaves crowd the silhouette. Real cards keep thin parts thin and surfaces flat, with a simpler contour.
